name: fleet_haiku_concentrated_ai_technology
strategy: Diversified AI infrastructure thesis emphasizing platform software (MSFT, CRM, SNOW) and supply-chain leverage (ASML, AMD) with reduced semiconductor concentration, positioned for Q4 2026 hyperscaler capex acceleration.
reassessment_note: Round 3 entered at elevated valuations (2026-09-16) with weak conviction holdings and underperformance (+0.62% vs SPY +2.73%). Current 26% cash position indicates lack of decisive thesis. Repositioning addresses three gaps: (1) Recent catalysts show clear differentiation—SNOW +21% post-Q2 earnings with structural AI data consumption multiplier; ASML +4.85% current entry with $2,157 analyst target (+37%); AMD up 118% YTD; (2) Prior R3 semiconductor concentration (NVDA 15%, QCOM 5%) creates downside risk in potential correction—reducing NVDA to 8% while maintaining exposure through AMD/ASML diversifies; (3) Platform software plays (MSFT/CRM/SNOW) now represent 54% vs semiconductors 25%, better risk-adjusted given valuation warnings. Supply-chain play (ASML 16%) offers leverage to $700B hyperscaler capex without direct execution risk.

positions.thesis: Enterprise AI platform leader trading at 12% consensus upside to $514 analyst target (Strong Buy from 30 analysts). Copilot adoption across Office/Azure shows broad platform moat. Direct exposure to $700B+ hyperscaler capex through Azure. Increased from R3's 18% to reflect confidence in enterprise AI monetization.

Best-in-class consumption-based data platform benefiting from structural AI acceleration. Q2 2026 beat (35% revenue growth, 62c EPS vs 45c exp) validated by 21% post-earnings pop. CEO emphasized AI agents create 'structural multiplier' for data consumption—agentic enterprise flywheel drives durable margin expansion. New position in R3 (was not held); consumption model offers recession resistance vs. traditional SaaS.

Semiconductor equipment monopoly (extreme ultraviolet lithography) benefits from $700B capex cycle. Current price $1,680 has 37% upside to $2,157 analyst target. Up 47.95% YTD, up 4.85% in current entry. Supply-chain leverage position—ASML sells to TSMC, Samsung, Intel; benefits from ALL chip demand without execution risk. Next earnings 2026-10-14.

Up 118% YTD with strong AI compute fundamentals. EPYC data center accelerating; MI AI accelerators gaining traction in hyperscaler clusters. Maintained vs. NVDA concentration to capture execution upside without peak-valuation risk. Strong management, clear roadmap (Ryzen, EPYC, MI stacks). Balances NVDA/QCOM in compute exposure.

Enterprise AI platform with Copilot momentum and $30B+ ARR base. Unique position monetizing AI for sales/service workflows. Maintained position (was 10% in R3 entry) reflects consistent execution and moat. Underweight relative to SNOW/MSFT to reflect later monetization cycle vs. platform scale plays.

GPU dominance in LLM training/inference continues; 49.84% upside to $328.66 analyst target. Reduced from R3's 15% to manage concentration risk and peak-valuation exposure—current $222.27 price reflects much of upside. Maintain core position for downside support; exposure through AMD/ASML offers better risk-reward for new capital allocation.

Small allocation to data-center AI chip competition. Up 15% in recent month on AI infrastructure bets. Tactical position for compute diversity and potential Snapdragon/Oryon AI acceleration in next-gen inference; low weight reflects uncertainty vs. NVDA/AMD track records but captures upside optionality.
